newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Venezuela's EDC started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Venezuela's EDC started.

text.p: ING Barings analyst Charles Barnett started coverage of Venezuelan power company Electricidad de Caracas SA Tuesday with a rating of buy.
-- The buy recommendation is based "the stock's potential price appreciation and prospects on Venezuela's expected power privatization," Barnett wrote in a report.
-- He set a 12-month price target of $1.85, showing a potential price appreciation of 48 percent in dollar terms.

-- Barnett recommended investors "take profits on more fully valued Brazil electrics, such as Eletropaulo and" Companhia Energetica de Sao Paulo, and use the proceeds to switch into Electricidad de Caracas.
-- The company's shares were up 13.50 bolivares at 621.50 in Caracas.
